captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 4. In this lesson: How to make fruit kebabs.
Follow and write instructions with imperatives and sequencing words.
Here are some new words. Ingredients. The foods you need to make a dish. Recipe.
Instructions for cooking something. Slice. Cut into thin pieces. Listen and say them.
ingredients
recipe
slice.
And some more words. Mix. Put things together and stir. Skewer.
A long thin stick for holding food. Serve. Give food to people. Listen and say them. mix
skewer
serve.
Time for a question. The video will stop.
Which word means: the foods you need to make a dish?
Now some grammar: Sequencing words and imperatives.
Instructions use imperative verbs and words like first, next, then,
after that and finally. For example: First, wash the fruit.
For example: Finally, serve the kebabs.
Now listen, and read along. Rainbow fruit kebabs. Ingredients: 6 strawberries, 1 banana,
10 grapes, 2 slices of pineapple, 4 wooden skewers, a small pot of yogurt,
1 spoon of honey. One. First, wash your hands and the fruit. Two.
Next, ask an adult to help you slice the banana and the pineapple. Three.
Then push the fruit carefully onto the skewers. Try to make a rainbow of colours!
Four. After that, mix the yogurt and honey in a bowl to make a dip. Five.
Finally, serve your kebabs with the dip. Enjoy!
Another question. The video will stop. How many strawberries do you need?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like ingredients, recipe, slice.
You practised sequencing words and imperatives. And you read Rainbow fruit kebabs.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!

captions: Hello, and welcome to Atomic English, Stage 4. In this lesson: A taste of the world.
Use countable and uncountable nouns with much, many, a lot of.
Here are some new words. Spicy. With a hot, strong taste. Delicious. Tasting very good.
Noodles. Long thin strips of food made from flour. Listen and say them. spicy
delicious
noodles.
And some more words. Bowl. A deep round dish. Menu. A list of the food in a restaurant.
Dessert. Sweet food you eat at the end of a meal. Listen and say them. bowl
menu
dessert.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: with a hot, strong taste?
Now some grammar: Countable and uncountable nouns. Countable nouns have a plural (apples).
Uncountable nouns don't (rice, water).
Use ‘many’ with countable nouns and ‘much’ with uncountable nouns in questions and negatives.
Use ‘a lot of’ with both. For example: How many eggs? For example: How much rice?
For example: a lot of noodles.
Now listen, and read along. The World Café menu. World Café. Today's menu.
Starters: Vietnamese spring rolls – crispy rolls with fresh vegetables.
Italian tomato soup with bread.
Main dishes: Japanese noodle soup – a big bowl of noodles with egg and vegetables.
Indian vegetable curry with rice (a little spicy!). Mexican tacos with beans and cheese.
Desserts: Thai mango sticky rice. British apple pie with cream.
Drinks: water, orange juice, milk tea. Our food is fresh and delicious.
Come and taste the world!
Another question. The video will stop. How many desserts are on the menu?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like spicy, delicious, noodles.
You practised countable and uncountable nouns. And you read The World Café menu.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
